[[Sergeant/Legends|Sergeant]] '''Hoff''' was a member of the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. Part of the [[Alliance Special Forces/Legends|Alliance Special Forces]], he was assigned to the [[Nishr Taskforce]] in [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]]. He commanded the small staff of mechanics and [[Technician/Legends|technicians]] at [[Nishr Base Seven]].
